task: 设置页文案重命名与鼠标选项移除；修复 GitHub Actions 检查失败

cases.acceptance_criterion: 通用 Tab 将加载图片时显示棋盘格重命名为打开图片后使用棋盘格背景。
cases.test_purpose: 验证棋盘格复选框在实际设置对话框中使用新的英文源文案。
cases.preconditions: QVApplication 已初始化，设置对话框可构造。
cases.steps: 构造 QVOptionsDialog，读取复选框文本并与新文案比较。
cases.expected_result: 文本精确等于 Use checkerboard background after opening image。
cases.postconditions: 销毁对话框并恢复临时语言设置。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 通用 Tab 将使用图片启动时重用窗口重命名为使用同一窗口打开图片。
cases.test_purpose: 验证复用窗口复选框的运行时文案和源码文案一致。
cases.preconditions: QVOptionsDialog 可构造且英文源翻译已安装。
cases.steps: 构造对话框，读取控件文本并比较目标字符串。
cases.expected_result: 文本精确等于 Open images in the same window。
cases.postconditions: 关闭对话框，不改变 reusewindow 的持久化值。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 删除后标签重命名为删除文件后。
cases.test_purpose: 验证删除策略标签的源文案与可见文本均已更新。
cases.preconditions: QVOptionsDialog 可构造，afterDeletionComboBox 所在 General 页面已组装。
cases.steps: 构造对话框并读取 label_10 文本。
cases.expected_result: 英文文本精确等于 After deleting files:。
cases.postconditions: 销毁对话框且不执行删除操作。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 删除文件后的下拉项不执行重命名为无动作。
cases.test_purpose: 验证 DoNothing 枚举仍保留行为值，但显示文本已改为 No Action。
cases.input_data: Qv::AfterDelete::DoNothing 的 itemData 和 itemText。
cases.steps: 按枚举值查找下拉项，读取显示文本。
cases.expected_result: 对应数据值仍是 DoNothing，英文显示文本精确等于 No Action。
cases.postconditions: 销毁对话框，不触发删除策略。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 鼠标 Tab 移除侧边导航区域选项，并固定默认值为不勾选。
cases.test_purpose: 验证 UI 不再暴露该选项，同时新安装和迁移后的设置值都是 false。
cases.preconditions: SettingsManager 默认库已初始化，QVOptionsDialog 可构造。
cases.input_data: navigationRegionsCheckbox 对象查找、navigationregionsenabled 默认值。
cases.steps: 读取默认设置并搜索生产对话框对象树。
cases.expected_result: checkbox 不存在，navigationregionsenabled 的默认值为 false。
cases.postconditions: 关闭对话框，不改变其它导航按钮行为。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 鼠标 Tab 移除中键模式选项，并固定默认值为点击。
cases.test_purpose: 验证模式标签、单选按钮和不可达的中键拖动设置行均不再出现在界面，内部默认保持 Click。
cases.preconditions: SettingsManager 默认库已初始化，Mouse 页面可构造。
cases.input_data: middleButtonModeLabel/Host/radio 控件、中键拖动控件和 viewportmiddlebuttonmode 默认值。
cases.steps: 读取默认枚举并在生产对话框对象树中查找所有已移除控件。
cases.expected_result: 模式及其依赖控件不存在，viewportmiddlebuttonmode 默认值为 Click。
cases.postconditions: 销毁对话框，不产生鼠标输入。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 旧配置中的侧边导航和中键模式值不能在移除选项后复活。
cases.test_purpose: 验证迁移逻辑将旧的 true/Drag 配置写回 false/Click。
cases.preconditions: QSettings 可写，firstlaunch 已标记，SettingsManager 迁移函数可调用。
cases.steps: 保存旧值，调用 migrateOldSettings()，同步并分别读取持久化值与内存值。
cases.expected_result: 持久化和内存结果分别为 false 与 Click。
cases.postconditions: 恢复迁移前的 QSettings 值。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 四个非英语目录同步更新所有重命名文案，并删除已移除选项的旧翻译。
cases.test_purpose: 验证 TS XML 可解析、目标 source 有完成翻译且精确匹配需求语言。
cases.preconditions: 四个 TS 文件和 XML 解析器可用。
cases.input_data: 五个新 source：两个 General 标签、删除文件后标签、No Action，以及四套期望译文。
cases.steps: 逐目录解析 XML，按 source 查找 translation，检查非空、非 unfinished 和精确文本；检查旧 source 不存在。
cases.expected_result: 西班牙语、日语、简体中文、繁体中文均通过，中文目标文案与需求逐字一致。
cases.postconditions: 不加载第五种语言，不改动运行时设置。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 静态、单元、集成、系统四级检查按顺序执行并可在 GitHub Actions 重放。
cases.test_purpose: 验证工作流使用仓库声明的 macOS runner、Qt 构建参数、CTest 和报告 artifact。
cases.preconditions: GitHub Actions workflow、CMake 测试注册和已构建测试/应用目标可读。
cases.input_data: test.yml runner/build/test/artifact 步骤与四级审计命令。
cases.steps: 静态检查 workflow 契约，依次运行 FeatureTests、WindowBehaviorTests 和真实 Fovelle system probe。
cases.expected_result: 四级结果可观测、顺序明确，三份 JSON 报告写入 reports/ 并可作为 Actions artifact 上传。
cases.postconditions: 保留完整命令、返回码、耗时和输出摘要，失败时返回非零。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 修复 CI-UNIT-002：滚动测试不得要求异步 refinement 在某一瞬间仍处于 pending，且 5% 判定只使用滚动后的首个 Paint。
cases.test_purpose: 验证 GitHub Actions 失败的唯一观察器修复既接受异步任务已提前完成的合法时序，又保留局部滚动重绘断言。
cases.preconditions: 已构建 fovelle_tests，macOS Cocoa 事件循环可用，解决方案与证明文件存在。
cases.input_data: GraphicsViewTests::testVectorPanRepaintsOnlyExposedStrip、首个 Paint dirty ratio 和 hasPendingVectorRefinement teardown 状态。
cases.steps: 执行静态异步观察合同；直接运行 CI-UNIT-002；检查首个 Paint 的 5% 断言和无瞬时 pending 必须为真的源码合同。
cases.expected_result: 静态合同通过，QtTest 返回 0，首个 Paint dirty ratio 不超过 5%，并在移除 event filter 前等待 refinement 收敛。
cases.postconditions: 测试窗口关闭，event filter 已移除；不修改生产渲染实现。

cases.acceptance_criterion: 120Hz 矢量交互预算必须以调用线程 CPU 执行时间测量，并保持平均值、p99 值和 120 FPS 容量断言稳定通过。
cases.test_purpose: 验证 GitHub Actions 中因调度器和 WindowServer 抖动产生的墙钟假失败已从应用线程 CPU 预算观测中排除。
cases.preconditions: 已构建 fovelle_tests，macOS Cocoa 事件循环可用，CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID 可用。
cases.input_data: GraphicsViewTests::testVectorInteractionPaintCpuBudgetFor120Hz、120 次 zoom/pan 样本和 1000/120 ms 阈值。
cases.steps: 执行静态 CPU 时钟合同；直接运行 120Hz QtTest；读取 thread_cpu、平均值、p99 和 CPU 容量观测。
cases.expected_result: 测试返回 0，样本由当前线程 CPU 时间差生成，平均值与 p99 不超过 1000/120 ms，CPU 容量至少为 120 FPS。
cases.postconditions: 测试窗口关闭，临时设置恢复；不修改生产渲染实现。

research_trace.finding: The latest Checks run for commit 119f5fe failed in Run Unit Tests; the hosted log reports a 120Hz CPU-budget assertion with average below the budget but p99 above it.
research_trace.explicit_premise: A failed GitHub Actions run log is the direct observation of the failing CI predicate.
research_trace.deduction: The first branch of the diagnosis must inspect the measured quantity and its threshold, not change the rendering implementation.

research_trace.finding: The corresponding Build Fovelle run also fails in the complete CTest path at testVectorInteractionPaintCpuBudgetFor120Hz, while the average samples remain well below 8.333 ms and a pan p99 contains a large outlier.
research_trace.explicit_premise: Two independent workflow jobs observe the same performance-test failure boundary.
research_trace.deduction: The failure is reproducible at the test observer level and is not an artifact of only the acceptance-audit wrapper.

research_trace.finding: The repository builds with CMake and runs the Qt tests on macos-26 with Qt 6.11.2, Cocoa, and CTest.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The hosted runner and the local test source are part of the test's stated execution contract.
research_trace.deduction: A timing-sensitive wall-clock measurement is exposed to hosted-runner scheduling even when application work is unchanged.

research_trace.finding: The macos-26 arm64 image records a changing hosted image identity and macOS/Xcode toolchain details.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The runner is a shared hosted environment rather than a dedicated real-time CPU.
research_trace.deduction: Descheduling and WindowServer delays are admissible wall-clock noise and cannot be treated as application CPU work.

research_trace.finding: QElapsedTimer provides elapsed monotonic wall time; it does not identify how much CPU execution the calling thread received.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The failing code used QElapsedTimer around synchronous QWidget::repaint().
research_trace.deduction: The old p99 predicate measured W_i = C_i + D_i, so a scheduling delay D_i could fail the test without a renderer regression.

research_trace.finding: POSIX defines CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID as CPU execution time for the calling thread and distinguishes it from elapsed real time.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The interactive zoom/pan operation and synchronous repaint execute on the Qt GUI thread.
research_trace.deduction: The repaired sample c_i = T_thread_end - T_thread_start directly measures the CPU quantity named by the existing test.

research_trace.finding: Qt recommends condition-based waits and warns that fixed timing assumptions are fragile in asynchronous tests.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The repository already uses explicit bounded QTest conditions for GUI readiness and teardown.
research_trace.deduction: The performance test should retain bounded functional setup but must not use scheduler-sensitive wall-time p99 as a CPU-work assertion.

research_trace.finding: The SettingsAudit static contract requires an explicit !reports/solution_and_proof.md rule, which was absent from the current .gitignore.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The latest SettingsAudit failure is an independent source-contract failure, not a consequence of the CPU benchmark.
research_trace.deduction: The complete fix must add the explicit report-tracking rule and preserve the proof artifact as part of the CI acceptance interface.

research_trace.finding: The repaired probe logs measurement=thread_cpu and directly exercises EPS/SVG zoom and pan samples; the audit registers the same method as an atomic unit case.
research_trace.explicit_premise: A test is reproducible only when its input, clock, selector, bounds, and output marker are explicit.
research_trace.deduction: The fix is testable without modifying production rendering or hiding the p99/120-FPS requirement.

research_trace.finding: GitHub documents using failed run logs and recorded runner information to diagnose a workflow failure.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The report must distinguish confirmed hosted observations, local verification, and claims not yet remotely rerun.
research_trace.deduction: Reports record the two pre-fix run URLs, explicit premises, local four-stage evidence, and remote_reexecution=false until a push/rerun occurs.
